target_customer: Automotive dealerships (sales, service and BDC departments) that pay to capture missed calls and leads
problem: Dealerships miss inbound calls and leads and follow up slowly, losing revenue; Clearline answers, follows up and books appointments with AI.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for dealerships (pricing not verified)
product_category: AI voice and CRM operating system for car dealerships

founders.name: Adi Patel
education: Queens (alum per a Substack subtitle; institution not specified)
founders.background_notes: Went through YC Summer 2022 with brother Abhi as Lancey per a Substack recap.

founders.name: Abhi Patel
founders.background_notes: Brother of Adi; listed as founder on YC page and CTO on a directory.

technical_complexity.rationale: Lancey was a front end demo cloner and later LLM feedback tool built on foundation models; thin application layers at the time.

defensibility.rationale: Founder says the LLM feedback product was undefensible because of token pricing and a new competitor with better prompts each quarter.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action documented; the founders shut down Lancey and pivoted to dealership AI as Clearline.

market_need_then: At founding the company built interactive product demos for sales teams (Lancey); evidence of demand was a Chrome extension and about 50,000 users on the later feedback product per a Substack recap.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, punchy: No more voicemail. Less chasing. More booked.

rebrands.why: Lancey was shut down and the founders restarted in dealership AI per a Substack recap; date not given

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared by several unrelated companies and no press about the brand.

pivots.from: Lancey, interactive demo and front end cloner
pivots.to: LLM feedback management for product teams
pivots.why: per a Substack recap, early LLMs enabled feedback sorting

pivots.to: Clearline, AI operating system for car dealerships
pivots.why: Founder called the prior business undefensible due to token pricing and competitors with thinner margins

outcome_analysis: The founders entered YC in Summer 2022 as Lancey, pivoted to LLM feedback management that reached 50,000 users, then shut it down citing token based pricing and quarterly competitor churn. They restarted as Clearline for car dealerships; the company is active with no public funding and early customer claims from a founder recap.
notes: Clearline is the second pivot of the S22 company; the YC batch product was Lancey and the competition list for it was not found in dated sources (Supademo and website cloners surfaced only in undated results). Dealership AI competitors found (Numa, Fullpath, Impel, Podium) are dated well after 2022 so are excluded. Funding not found in any source. YC page lists only Adi and Abhi Patel. Clearline site claims are marketing; customer recovery figures come from a Substack recap of a founder dinner.
